question: What auspicious matter concerning time does the speaker now wish to hear?
premises: The speaker now wishes to hear something.
The object of hearing is the deception of time.
That matter is described as auspicious.
inference: The speaker now wishes to hear the auspicious account of the deception of time.
uncertainties: Why the deception of time is called auspicious not specified
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.
